name: Shipments
description: One row per order line of the Sample Database, read as a shipment. Industry is the product category, customer is the person who ordered, units are the order quantity.

SHIPPED_AT.description: Order creation time, used as the shipment date

INDUSTRY.description: Product category (Doohickey, Gadget, Gizmo, Widget), standing in for the customer's industry

CUSTOMER.description: PEOPLE.NAME. Two people share a name in the Sample Database; the dashboards group by name.
